generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Modular leather HARNESS AND BELT waist-slot wearable for Santi Wong. References approvedSanti design and turnaround show darkbrown shoulder suspenders connected to wide belt at his broad belly, small squared brass buckles and hardware, restrained leather pouches and empty toolloops at hips. Only that connected harness/belt and attached leather pouch/loops, no pots spoons knives ladles or hanging metal cookware. Match originalSanti, no new armor or modern holster. Belt wraps broad barrel waist; two shoulder straps rise to shoulders and run down rear to belt. Front straps parallel down chest, no cross on front. Buckles modest wornbrass, darkwarmbrown leather broad clean planes, chunky cartoon rendering, no grainy realistic leathertexture.
Entire invisible torso space must show PUREWHITE background THROUGH shoulder/waist strap openings; don't fill harness with brown mannequin or fabric. No skin, body, trousers, apron, shirt, scarf, hat or props. Empty wearable harness, connected suspension straps to continuous belt, plausible thickness. Show front waist buckle and rear plain belt, pouches stay on same anatomical side acrossviews. A few small empty tool loops on sides.
Fit to same Santi broad torso in T-pose; no sleeves/arms. Four LEVEL cardinal orthographic views FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT in horizontal row, one shared scale and identical shoulderstrap-top and belt/pouch-bottom envelope. Full garment in eachview, physically narrow side profiles, clean wide white separators and outermargins. No labels text borders groundline shadows or scenery. No change reference costume.
